batch: RC489 proposals from the independent RC488 audit
status_note: PROPOSED - awaiting owner approval; nothing applied
audit: /tmp scratch audit-manuscript.json summarised in production/qa (to be archived)

patches.issue: Forsaken Duelist Attacks list matches its AI step and Counterthrust (and the 7.8 Rapier, piercing)
patches.find: - **Rapier:** 1d8 slashing damage.
patches.replace: - **Rapier:** 1d8 + 4 piercing damage.

patches.issue: Giant Scorpion has no Burrow: flavour no longer buries and erupts
patches.find: It buries itself in the dunes and erupts beneath whatever walks over it.
patches.replace: It lies half-buried in the dunes and lunges at whatever walks past.

patches.issue: Undead Sentinel: no shield rule and size M
patches.find: towering dead men in tower-shield and reach-halberd.
patches.replace: tall dead men in iron helm and reach-halberd.

patches.issue: Tomb Guardian flavour claims an aura it does not have
patches.find: lends its iron resolve to the dead around it,
patches.replace: cannot be hurried or frightened,

patches.issue: Spectre: Silvered weapons are not magical (7.x Magical weapons)
patches.find: Steel finds nothing to bite; only silver and magic answer.
patches.replace: Steel finds nothing to bite; only magic answers.

patches.issue: Ice Wraith: Silvered weapons are not magical
patches.find: Steel passes clean through; only silver and magic bite.
patches.replace: Steel passes clean through; only magic bites.

patches.issue: Gloomspore Jelly: man-sized (coded M); no splitting or engulf rule
patches.find: A translucent grey ooze the size of a cart, the gloomspore jelly creeps over every surface and dissolves whatever it engulfs. Slashing only splits it, and it feels neither pain nor fear.
patches.replace: A translucent grey ooze the size of a man, the gloomspore jelly creeps over every surface and dissolves whatever it touches. It feels neither pain nor fear.

patches.issue: Noxcloth has no light-snuffing rule
patches.find: With a gout of unnatural gloom it can snuff a torch outright.

patches.issue: Iron Golem resists blades (Immutable) but has no spell resistance
patches.find: it shrugs off blade and spell alike and answers with piledriver fists. Magic washes from its plates; edged steel skids away.
patches.replace: it shrugs off sword and spear alike and answers with piledriver fists. Edged steel skids from its plates.

patches.issue: Bandit: Dirty Fighting does not trigger on Bleeding
patches.find: they fight dirtiest against anything already bleeding.
patches.replace: they fight dirtiest against anything already down.

patches.issue: Elder Vrymk has no Reach attack
patches.find: then makes their attacks against the nearest enemy in **Reach**, if able.
patches.replace: then makes their attacks against the nearest enemy within the melee distance of their attacks, if able.

patches.issue: Pale City 3 spirits use the Pale City Ice Wraith
patches.find: Use the canonical **Spectre** profile with **LVL 3**
patches.replace: Use the canonical **Ice Wraith** profile with **LVL 3**

patches.issue: Greenmark objective: Greenmark creature
patches.find: Disturbs a Stirge nest. Place **1d3 Stirge** adjacent
patches.replace: Disturbs a Giant Tarantula nest. Place **1d3 Giant Tarantulas** adjacent
